warnings.VIDEO_IS_AUDIO: Same file for the music and the video: {file}
warnings.VIDEO_TOO_LARGE: Video {width}×{height}: larger than 1080p, heavy for UltraStar (1080p is enough)

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: Enter the access key given by the library owner.
auth.localHint: Full access: you are on the PC running the server.
auth.publicHint: Browsing and listening are open to everyone. Sign in with a key to edit.
auth.signInHint: Sign in to edit (write or admin key)

details.title: Song details
details.error: Could not read this song file.
details.creator: Creator

encoding.hint: Rewrites the file in UTF-8 without BOM: same text and line endings, dated backup first.
encoding.converted: File converted from {from} to UTF-8 (without BOM). Backup: {backup}

bulk.title: Bulk corrections
bulk.intro: Each correction is simulated first: nothing is written until you confirm. Every changed file is backed up first.
bulk.changedSinceSimulation: changed since the simulation: skipped (simulate again)

utf8.title: Convert to UTF-8 (without BOM)
utf8.hint: Rewrites files saved in another encoding (or with a BOM): same text and line endings.
utf8.none: All song files are already in UTF-8 without BOM.

video.title: Convert videos to MP4 H.264
video.hint: Original resolution kept, reduced to 1080p if larger (never enlarged). Videos are converted one after the other in the background: you can close this window.
video.none: All videos are already MP4 H.264.
video.space: The originals are moved to the backups: plan about {size} of free disk space for the selected videos.
video.stopped: Batch stopped: {converted} converted, {errors} error(s), {skipped} not processed.
video.isAudio: also the music (#MP3): create the MP3 from the details window first

video.hint: Original resolution kept, reduced to 1080p if larger (never enlarged). Light to play for UltraStar and browsers.
video.planNew: {from} will be converted to {to}; #VIDEO will be updated and the original moved to the backups.
video.planReplace: {from} will be replaced by its H.264 version; the original will be moved to the backups.
video.duration: This can take a few minutes.
video.done: Video converted: {file}. Original saved in the backups: {backup}
video.unavailable: ffmpeg not found: set FFMPEG_PATH in .env to enable conversion.
video.isAudio: The video file is also the song’s music: create the MP3 file first (warning above), then the video can be converted.

musicbrainz.title: MusicBrainz
musicbrainz.intro: Look up the year, language and genre of this song on MusicBrainz, then choose what to keep.
musicbrainz.noResult: Nothing found on MusicBrainz for this artist and title.
musicbrainz.hint: Ticked values replace the current ones. Nothing is written until you apply.

playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.none: No playlist in the playlist folder.
playlists.readOnly: Sign in with write access to add or remove this song.

audio.hint: Extracts the music from the video into its own MP3 file (the video is not changed), then the video can be converted.
audio.plan: {to} will be created from the soundtrack of {from}; #AUDIO / #MP3 will point to it. The video is not changed.
audio.planReuse: {to} already exists (created for another version of this song): #AUDIO / #MP3 will point to it.
audio.doneReuse: Music now points to the existing {file} ({headers} updated). Backup: {backup}
